name: Daily ad audit
summary: Each morning reads yesterday's results from the client's ad accounts, checks them against the agreed thresholds, and queues any campaign pause for a person to approve. Crons read and queue; nothing changes in an ad account until a person approves it.

daily-account-check.evidence: 2 discovery calls describe a daily audit of client ad accounts; platform pages support the reads

covered_by.check-tracking: skill (no mapped read for pixel events)

crons.name: pull
crons.summary: Yesterday's campaign results for each Meta ad account (22:00 UTC is 6 or 7 am in eastern Australia).

crons.name: audit
crons.summary: Check the snapshot against thresholds, write the findings, and queue pauses for approval.

draft_ops_note: Reads only. Nothing in this workflow writes a draft to a client or a platform: findings are stored for the account manager to read.

meta-ads.covers: account and campaign insights, campaign pause (queued for approval)

gaps: TikTok Ads: the TikTok pages read for this job describe no daily pull, pacing check or pixel verification, and TikTok is not in the kit's platform set yet. Not built.
Google Ads: mapped in the kit (customers.googleAds.search, customers.campaigns.mutate) but no adapter here yet. Its OAuth path is not proven in a test, so it is left out rather than shipped untested.
Pixel and conversion-tag checks: no mapped read confirms events are firing. The skill checks this by hand.
Budget pacing: the audit compares yesterday's spend with the account budget in settings, and only as far as the insights call returns it.

Paging: the insights read returns only the first page of campaign rows. Following paging.next needs core: AdAccount.get.insights in core/sdk/platforms/meta-ads/ops.json maps limit but no after parameter, and the SDK refuses unmapped params. Until then, campaigns past that page are not audited and pacing can be understated.
Creative and targeting review, priorities and client notes are judgment steps for the skill. No mapped platform write exists for a note, so none is drafted.
Every adapter is docs-only until a test ad account proves the reads and the approved pause against real data.

evidence.calls: 2 agency discovery calls name a daily ad audit; no call maps a platform operation step by step
evidence.platforms: TikTok Ads pages read (30 pages); mapped kit platforms used for this job: Meta Marketing API and Google Ads
